claim.quote: These data provide the most stringent direct detection constraints on weakly interacting massive particle (WIMP)-proton spin-dependent scattering to date for WIMP masses $<$ 50$\,$GeV/c$^2$.

name: Improved dark matter search results from PICO-2L Run 2

summary.plain: A second run of the two-litre chamber, cleaned of particles that had caused odd background events in the first run, saw one candidate event and set the strongest limits then on spin-dependent WIMP-proton scattering for lighter WIMPs.
summary.technical: 129 kg-days at a 3.3 keV thermodynamic threshold; one single nuclear-recoil event, consistent with the predicted neutron background and the observed multiple-bubble neutron rate; the anomalous background events of run 1 absent after particulate-contamination controls (Phys. Rev. D 93, 061101).

title: Improved dark matter search results from PICO-2L Run 2
why_it_matters: The abstract states these are the most stringent direct-detection constraints to date on WIMP-proton spin-dependent scattering for masses below 50 GeV/c^2.
